_comment: One entry per journey. flow = flows/<name> without .yaml (also the JUnit testcase name and the debug-output subdir). category must be one of categories (drives report tabs). mode = critical | happy | all (report badge; keep in sync with the tags: block in the flow YAML, which drives run selection). q/a = the human-readable question + answer shown on the report card. planned: true renders a gray card with no screenshots, so the report doubles as the full e2e plan. Optional shots: <n> raises the screenshot cap for wide journeys like screen-walk.
title: Acme flows
intro: Every journey the app walks on its own before a release, with the pictures to prove it.

journeys.q: Does every screen load without an error?
journeys.a: Opens every top-level screen and fails if any renders the app's error copy.
From the welcome screen to a loaded home screen with a real test account.
Marked planned until its flow is built.
